dog.description_text: Hi, I'm Chad! 🐕 I'm a 2-year-old tan and white mixed breed with a laid-back vibe that makes me the perfect companion for a relaxed household. Already neutered and ready to settle in, I'm an affectionate, loyal boy who does wonderfully with children and appreciate a calm, low-energy lifestyle. I'm all about the simple things — your company, a cozy spot, and being by your side. My adoption fee is $325, and I'd love to find my forever family. Come say hello! ❤️ I reside at our Westhampton location.
dog.name: Chad
